domanda: Quante questioni sospensive sono state votate alla Camera in questa legislatura e con quale esito?
sql:
SELECT v.uri, v.date, v.title, v.description, v.favor, v.against, v.abstain, v.approved,
       a.uri AS atto_camera, left(a.title, 160) AS titolo_atto
FROM vote v
LEFT JOIN vote_act va ON va.vote = v.uri
LEFT JOIN act a ON a.uri = va.act AND a.chamber = 'camera'
WHERE v.chamber = 'camera' AND v.legislature = 19
  AND (v.kind = 'suspensive_question' OR v.title ILIKE '%sospensiv%' OR v.description ILIKE '%sospensiv%')
ORDER BY v.date
